DSWD Field Office V — Bicol Region

Empowering Our Local Frontliners
to Make an Impact in
Their Communities

A unified digital platform for Local Social Welfare and Development Offices to request, track, and coordinate Resource Person assignments from DSWD's Core Group of Specialists across the Bicol Region.

How the System Works

From request to implementation — every step is tracked, notified, and documented.

Submit Requests Online
LGUs and SWDAs submit Resource Person requests directly through the platform. No more paper letters or follow-up calls.
Track in Real Time
Monitor every step of your request from submission through review, endorsement, confirmation, and final approval.
Expert Specialists Ready
Access DSWD's Core Group of Specialists across all programs and technical domains in the Bicol Region.
